site.subtitle: Where humans and agents meet, experiment, build, play, and create together.

announcement.text: Atlas first release: every card is checked against its own sources before it is published.

_help.announcement: Set enabled=false to hide. Change id whenever the text changes: visitors who dismissed the old id will see the new message.
_help.ad_slots: enabled=false renders nothing. With creative=null and placeholder=true the slot shows a neutral 'Sponsored / Your ad here' box; placeholder=false renders nothing. A creative looks like {"href": "https://example.com", "title": "Sponsor name", "text": "One line", "image": "/atlas/assets/ads/file.png", "alt": "..."}; links get rel="sponsored nofollow noopener". size=[width,height] in CSS px is reserved so nothing shifts. 'atlas-native-card' is the native sponsored card shown in the catalog grid after every 12 visible cards (same card style; creative uses href/title/text, no image).
_help.default_theme: 'light' (default) or 'dark': the theme a first-time visitor sees. Visitors' own choice is remembered.
_help.share: Share buttons on platform pages (a compact row in the header card next to the Visit button, once per page) and on the Atlas index. enabled=false hides them. networks = which buttons, in order: any of x, linkedin, telegram, reddit, facebook, email, copy. native=true adds a 'Share' button that uses the phone's share sheet (Web Share API); it only appears where the browser supports it on touch devices. Links are plain share-intent URLs (no third-party scripts). A GA4 'share' event (method = network) is sent only if the visitor accepted analytics cookies.
_help.product_url: Cross-product navigation: the main Commonworld product. Used by the 'Commonworld' item at the top of the left sidebar and by the top-right home icon. Default https://commonworld.one/; for a local preview of both products on one server build with --local (sets it to '/').
_help.contact: general = main mailbox for contact, corrections and advertising (About, Terms, Organization JSON-LD); privacy = privacy@ for data/privacy requests only (Privacy page, Terms privacy pointer).
_help.data_licence: null = no licence chosen yet (pages say so). Set a string such as 'CC BY 4.0' and the About/Terms pages and snapshot.json show it.
_help.legal_draft: false since 2026-10-16 (owner approved the final text). true would add 'This policy is a draft and may change before launch.' to the Privacy and Terms pages; check.py fails if the note appears while this is false.
_help.legal: operator/location shown on the Privacy and Terms pages; last_updated (YYYY-MM-DD) is printed as 'Last updated' on both pages; privacy_last_updated / terms_last_updated, when set, override it for that page only (a change to one page); ga_retention must match the Google Analytics property's data-retention setting (2 months or 14 months).
